description: Upserts a config value in the multi-scope config plane (EP-341) on the (scope, scope_id, key) unique key. A non-secret value goes inline in `value`; a secret keeps only its sdk-secrets envelope pointer in `secret_ref` (value XOR secret_ref). Tenant JWT required; a tenant may only write its OWN tenant/app/app_user rows (403 otherwise) and platform scope requires a platform operator. Edge cases: scope must be platform|tenant|app|app_user and key is required (400); providing both value and secret_ref is 400. This definition is the sole PRODUCER of the config row every other /api/config test consumes: it captures the created key as config.create.response.data.key, and the readers, the revoke and the rotate definitions all reference that capture rather than assuming a seeded row. The upsert is what makes the whole chain re-runnable - each run resets qa.config.smoke to an active row carrying `value`, so the readers see a value, revoke can then revoke it and rotate can then swap it to a secret_ref, in that declared order.

errorCases.message: provide value OR secret_ref, not both

errorCases.when: tenant scope_id != caller tenant, or platform scope without operator role
